annotation_unit: pending primary-source verification; intended model input is one post
author_rule: exclude prior authors if identifiers exist; repeated sampled authors require a cluster design before analysis

candidate_policy.calibration: none in primary policy; sigmoid/fusion are secondary
candidate_policy.development: all 5,000 historical cache rows; supplied labels not verified expert reference
candidate_policy.fallback: retain comparator decision at frozen XGBoost threshold

question.instructions: On a scale of 0 to 1, how likely is it that this text indicates a risk of suicidal intent?

candidate_policy.target_scope: historical routed score-range only; not a guaranteed global recall target
candidate_policy.truncation: no client truncation; provider context handling unknown

human_review: separate probability and enriched disagreement samples; blinded descriptive coding; no LLM-generated expert labels
inference: paired stratified bootstrap of weighted contribution totals; finite-frame correction for census strata; expected random-routing outcome at exact population referral fraction; no ordinary McNemar for weighted/random expectations
owner_live_authorization: Already granted up to 10000 additional attempts; no repeat financial approval needed
population: candidate: unqueried original test posts after training/development/history/duplicate exclusions; aggregate test exposure disclosed
positive_construct: pending source definition and paper-to-release record mapping; current cache is supplied suicide/non-suicide labels
primary_effect: comparator false alarms per 1000 minus selective false alarms per 1000; positive favors assistance
primary_sensitivity: assisted minus comparator sensitivity with paired design-appropriate interval; no preservation claim without justified margin
question: Does selective JEV reduce false-positive flags per 1000 posts relative to tuned XGBoost, with an estimated paired sensitivity difference against a verified compatible reference?

sampling.allocation: Historical development; zero planned paid repeats; census residual route if feasible, probability sample both exterior strata. Final n<=10000 selected only after complete frame and design-aware precision review.
sampling.n_status: no final quota or sample size frozen while outside-stratum disagreements/frame are unknown
sampling.outside_score_regions: No JEV evidence. Random-routing contrast uncertainty outside coverage cannot be estimated from cached inside-range outcomes.
sampling.repeated_author_effect: Design-effect scenarios illustrate loss of precision; not measured intraclass correlation.
sampling.warning: Excluding the historical cache changes the population route fraction drastically. These aggregate counts do not supply row IDs, labels or final author/near-duplicate exclusions.

secondary: budget-matched random referral using identical JEV cutoff/fallback
local word/character TF-IDF logistic baseline if raw training/development texts available
sigmoid calibration and fusion as supplementary only
